prompt: Continue Phase 6 by making provider sessions crash-resumable at the cycle layer. Refactor src/ade/cycle.py without changing existing run_cycle behavior. Add an immutable validated CycleSession handle containing task_id, session_id, and optional session_url. Add start_cycle_session(provider, *, task, source_name) that creates exactly one provider session and returns CycleSession. Add monitor_cycle_session(provider, *, task, session, sleeper=sleep, clock=monotonic) that polls an already-created session and returns CycleResult without ever calling create_session. Preserve the existing COMPLETED, FAILED, AWAITING_USER_FEEDBACK, PAUSED, and timeout semantics. Make run_cycle a thin composition of start_cycle_session followed by monitor_cycle_session. Export the new public API from ade.__init__. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage proving existing run_cycle still creates exactly one session, monitor resumes an existing session without create_session, completed result/PR extraction works, and failed/human-wait/paused/timeout states remain explicit. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, scripts, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
title: Add resumable provider session primitives
